title: Part Twenty-One: Promises, Conflicts and the Ending

sections.brief: Fishback's 18 Feb 2025 'DOGE dividend' memo (20% of $2T, ~$5,000 per household after July 2026); Musk 'Will check with the President'; Trump 19 Feb 'under consideration', 'I love it'; Johnson, Tillis, Hawley, Maloy, Moore; appropriation needed; arithmetic at $215bn (~$550) and GAO-26-108615's audit of $110.34bn; never legislated or paid; ORANGE; status NOT-ATTEMPTED; worst case: endorsement and non-payment documented, bad faith not supported, Congress as the check. Figures: flow, stats

Recusal promise (Leavitt) vs GAO-26-108403 (no financial disclosures); PSI minority count (65 matters, 11 agencies, $2.37bn); matter by matter: DOJ SpaceX refugee suit dropped (Feb 2025), FAA $633,009 proposed penalties and Whitaker (no evidence Musk forced him out), NLRB enjoined by 5th Cir. (Aug 2025), SEC Twitter-stake settlement $1.5M with judge's 'red flags' (July 2026), NHTSA's 2.9M-car FSD probe (Oct 2025), CFPB payment-app CRA repeal and X Money; contracts: FAA Starlink tests and Peraton integrator award, NSSL, launch EO, Golden Dome, GSA xAI $0.42, Palantir ImmigrationOS and Army EA as sequence; documented/probable/not supported. Figures: compare, money

Musk's exit (28-30 May 2025, 'not the end of DOGE'), feud, regret, America Party, Kirk memorial, 'a little bit successful', Medal of Science; Kupor 'doesn't exist'; no closing report (Vought); 4 July 2026 termination, USDS continues ($35M), GAO 206 personnel; alumni to NDS and CMS; what persisted: GAO -256k, Schedule Policy/Career, FOIA cert No. 25-1103; claims ledger (5 ORANGE, 1 YELLOW, 1 GREY, 0 RED); worst-case reading tested for Book III as a whole, linking de17-de20. Figures: time, compare
